messages:
elinor: Customer (AcmeMobile) opened ticket 34210: mobile app sees SSE streaming cut off mid-event, then reconnects and we see duplicate completion and duplicate billing. They attached client logs and server trace id `trace-8a1f`. Repro on iOS 16.4, intermittent (~1/50 sessions). Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/34210
support-bot: Thanks for filing elinor! Escalating to eng-oncall.
raj: Oncall—can you paste client curl/repro + any nginx/ALB logs? Which LB in front of the origin? Cloudflare? ALB? Any TLS resumption involved?
elinor: Stack: Cloudflare (proxy) -> ALB -> nginx origin -> Redwood app. Client uses an SSE polyfill that falls back to HTTP/1.1 longpoll in some networks. Repro curl (works intermittently):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" --no-buffer "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-large&session=acme-xyz"
```
When it breaks we see last line from client: `data: "partial token:\"Hel\"` then connection closed. Server logs near same time show `upstream prematurely closed connection while sending response` in nginx error log. ALB target logs show `healthStatus=OK request_processing_time=0.121 target_processing_time=0.045 response_processing_time=0.000 elb_status_code=502 target_status_code=502` and Cloudflare shows `Error: 522` in edge logs.
mobile-eng: We suspect Cloudflare TCP endpoint is sending FIN due to idle probe mismatch with ALB idle timeout (ALB default 60s). iOS keeps TCP in background and TLS session gets resumed causing the worker to handshake oddly. Half-close leads origin to see EOF and close mid-event.
raj: That matches. Two issues: 1) truncated SSE event causing client to treat last event incomplete and reconnect; 2) reconnection currently replays same request and backend re-emits completion—billing doubled. Immediate mitigation for customer: set shorter client-side heartbeat (send a comment/event every 10s) so connection doesn't go idle; or send small whitespace every 15s. Also ask infra to raise ALB idle_timeout to 300s for the target group.
nathan: For the billing duplication we can gate finalization by idempotency token: if client reconnects with same `X-Stream-Session` header, server should dedupe completions within 2 min window. We don't have this in prod yet. Quick workaround: ask customer to include a unique `x-client-session` and we can manually dedupe for affected invoices.
elinor: I posted repro logs and the specific trace: trace-8a1f. Customer agrees to try heartbeat change in next build. They asked if we have a server-side config they can toggle. Any quick proxy flags we can flip on Cloudflare?
mobile-eng: Cloudflare: disable `http2` to origin (force h1) helped in a similar case, but that could increase latency. Alternatively enable `Origin Keepalive` (Cloudflare setting) and turn off `proxy_buffering` on nginx for that endpoint. nginx snippet we recommend:
```
location /v1/streams {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_request_buffering off;
  proxy_set_header Connection "keep-alive";
}
```
raj: Action items:
- mobile-eng: provide heartbeat patch to customer (ETA 1 day)
- eng-infra: try ALB idle_timeout -> 300s on staging for repro (ETA 2d)
- billing: flag invoices for customer for potential manual dedupe if duplication confirmed (nathan)
- support: ask customer to add `x-client-session` header and hold billing until we confirm (elinor)
support-bot: Marked as P2 escalation. Adding incident label.
deploy-bot: @raj created staging deployment `sse-heartbeat-proxy` (deploy-9421) to test proxy buffering changes.
raj: If staging repros, we can add server-side session dedupe. Keep updates here.
elinor: Customer scheduled to try heartbeat change tomorrow. I'll update ticket when they confirm. :pray:
